Upstream facebook_auth_desktop 2.3.0, MIT, https://pub.dev/packages/facebook_auth_desktop/versions/2.3.0 . Only the flutter_secure_storage constraint is updated to11.2: the used read/write/delete/containsKey APIs are unchanged. This avoids downgrading the app session/key vault. Native Android/iOS Facebook login uses the original flutter_facebook_auth plugin. Retain the upstream license. Review this override when upstream supports secure_storage11.
